newsitem.title: FRANCE: Publicis has no comment on True North.
newsitem.headline: Publicis has no comment on True North.

text.p: French advertising agency Publicis said on Monday that a report in the London Financial Times that it and U.S. group True North would dissolve their European Publicis-FCB joint network was "pure speculation".

The newspaper reported that the agreement would give True North, the advertising agency, control of four to six of the European offices in Publicis-FCB while Publicis would take over the rest of the network. There would also be new cooperative arrangements in other parts of the world, the newspaper said.

Publicis would retain a 20 percent stake in True North which would in turn increase its stake in Publicis Communications, an unquoted unit of the group, to about 25 percent from 20 percent, the newspaper said.
The deal would end a partnership which began in 1988 but became troubled over the following years, the newspaper said.
